scripts.build: npm run build -w apps/web && npm run build -w apps/desktop
scripts.start: npm run build -w apps/web && npm run start -w apps/server
scripts.desktop: npm run build && npm run start -w apps/desktop
scripts.test: npm run test -w apps/server && npm run test -w apps/web && npm run test -w apps/desktop
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w apps/server && npm run typecheck -w apps/web && npm run typecheck -w apps/desktop
